verdict.rationale: Aleph documents an in-product agent, reachable by tagging it in Slack, whose answers trace back to the source of truth with clickable, cited sources. Its Scan variance analysis also claims it won't hallucinate when nothing material is found, and the platform runs calculations and stores metrics in its data layer. However, the docs never state that the agent's figures are computed by the calculation engine rather than generated by the model. Runway and forecast Q&A through the agent are not shown, and there is no evidence of a programmatic or API path for an external agent (OpenAPI probes return 404). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that agent figures come from the calculation engine rather than the LLM, documented runway/forecast queries via the agent, programmatic agent access, independent or hands-on corroboration of the lineage.
